name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: A Russian drone strike on flats in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, killed at least 10 on 22 Nov, after a mass strike on 20 Nov
state: A Russian drone attack overnight into 22 Nov destroyed part of an apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast; the regional governor reported at least 10 killed and the interior minister at least six injured (Kyiv Independent). Overnight into 20 Nov Russia launched more than 100 missiles and about 400 drones, mostly at energy targets, per Ukraine's Air Force; the prime minister reported 8 killed and 28 injured nationwide (Kyiv Post; The Defense Post). Repeated mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is advised against by the FCDO; follow its travel advice. Strikes on energy infrastructure cause rolling power and heating cuts across Ukraine as winter sets in, and can affect European gas and power prices.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes (100+ missiles and ~400 drones 20 Nov; at least 10 killed in Dymer 22 Nov)
